description: Thailand's post-rock band Inspirative deliver expansive, guitar-driven soundscapes in our latest Live on KEXP session at AXEAN Festival.
title: Inspirative performs "Follow the GPS" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with Inspirative performing at Puri Bhagawan. Recorded August 30, 2026.

Songs:
Follow the GPS 00:48
After 27 Years, I’m Alive 08:16
The Last Journey 12:11
Why 20:02

Noppanan Panicharoen - Guitar
Wuttipong Huangpetch - Keyboard/Vocal
Suthasinee Suwanwalaikorn - Drums
Chaturon Changthong - Bass
Katawut Chandaeng - Guitar
Narunjutha Punyasukh - FOH

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN and Jimbaran Hijab. Recorded at Puri Bhagawan, in Bali, Indonesia.

Audio Recording & Mix:  Matt Ogaz
Guest Audio Engineer: Narunjutha Punyasukh
